# MakaLight 0.1.0 — flagship Windows studio

First public **MakaLight** release alongside [makalive.stream](https://makalive.stream).

See [.github/RELEASE_NOTES_MAKALIGHT_TEMPLATE.md](./RELEASE_NOTES_MAKALIGHT_TEMPLATE.md) for layout; this tag pins **0.1.0** from `desktop-wails/wails.json`.

**Install:** `MakaLight-amd64-installer.exe` from release assets.

**Includes:** open MAKA.relay, WHIP ingest, studio UI synced 1:1 from Electron renderer, WebView2 shell, no in-app browser.
